mo_ta_cong_viec:
IriTech Incorporation is the global leader in iris recognition technology, delivering advanced biometric solutions including high-performance iris cameras, portable authentication devices, OEM modules, and iris recognition software for governments, enterprises, and emerging applications in mobile, automotive, AR/VR, and more.
To support our innovative software development and integration of iris biometrics into diverse platforms, we are seeking a talented Software Engineer to join our engineering team.
In this role, you will design, develop, and optimize software for IriTech's iris recognition solutions, ensuring secure, reliable, and high-performance operation across Windows, Linux, and Android environments.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and maintain software applications and SDKs for iris biometric devices, including portable scanners, enrollment cameras, and OEM modules.
Integrate software solutions with underlying firmware and hardware platforms running on Windows, Linux, and Android.
Design and implement robust application programming interfaces (APIs) for biometric authentication and data processing.
Conduct debugging, testing, and performance tuning on target software platforms.
Research, evaluate, and implement new software technologies to enhance application performance and security.
Collaborate with hardware, firmware, and product teams to deliver software for government projects (e.g., national ID programs) and commercial biometric solutions.
Document software architecture, implementation details, and contribute to internal knowledge sharing.
yeu_cau:
Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field from a reputable university.
3+ years of professional experience in software development (fresh graduates with strong relevant projects and skills will be considered).
Proficiency in C/C++ programming, alongside other relevant languages like Java or C#.
Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, data structures, and software architecture.
Experience developing applications and system services for Windows, Linux, or Android.
Experience with debugging tools and version control (Git).
Excellent problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to work with technical documentation.
Good English communication skills (written and spoken).
Team-oriented mindset: diligent, reliable, dynamic, and collaborative.
